top_recommendation: Do not build on an MD Python API (none exists). Validate the file-interchange envelope once by hand: human opens MD, imports the existing slotted .obj, simulates a drape, exports .usd+.fbx; confirm UE ingest (d) from the exported file. Automate everything outside MD (OBJ prep now, UE ingest after). If a repeatable high-frequency MD solve is ever required, use Houdini Vellum/SOP (hython) on the same OBJ rather than MD Python.
